finding.claim: The /logo handler fetches a user-supplied URL after only a substring check for "example.io". The check is applied to the raw string, not the parsed host. An attacker can pass http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/?x=example.io, http://evil.com/#example.io, or http://example.io.evil.com/. The server then requests an arbitrary host, including internal and metadata addresses. The response body is copied back to the attacker, so this is a full-read SSRF. Redirects are followed by default because http.Get is used.
finding.source: r.FormValue("logo") (query or form parameter on unauthenticated GET/POST /logo)
finding.sink: http.Get(raw) at main.go:36, with the response streamed to the client via io.Copy at main.go:38

trace.note: Route /logo registered with http.HandleFunc and no auth middleware
raw := r.FormValue("logo") takes the attacker-controlled URL
strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") is the only validation and matches anywhere in the string
http.Get(raw) uses the default client with redirects followed, no scheme, host or IP restrictions, and no timeout
Response body is returned to the attacker

finding.guards_checked: Substring contains check only. There is no url.Parse, no host allowlist, no scheme check, no private/loopback/link-local IP blocking, and no redirect restriction. The default http.Get follows redirects, so even a genuine example.io host that redirects would be followed. There is no auth on the route. The /cdn handler's exact-hostname allowlist and no-redirect client are not applied here.

verdict.guard_found: none (only strings.Contains(raw, "example.io") at main.go:32, a substring check that does not close the finding)
verdict.reason: Strictly, the trace is misdescribed: main.go:42 registers /cdn, not /logo (that is main.go:43). The underlying SSRF is real, though: r.FormValue("logo") at main.go:31 is attacker-controlled, the only guard is the substring check at main.go:32, and http.Get(raw) at main.go:36 follows redirects and io.Copy at main.go:38 returns the body. Correcting the line number to 43 would make this CONFIRMED.
